title: Air pollution
content: Air pollution is the condition in which air contains a high concentration of air pollutants that may harm living things and also damage non-living things[cite: 1].

title: Global warming
content: Global warming is the increase in the Earth's average temperature due to the built-up of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere[cite: 1].

title: Acid rain
content: Acid rain is formed when acidic air pollutants mainly sulphur dioxide and nitrogen dioxide react with water in the air (atmosphere)[cite: 1].

title: Hard water
content: Hard water is water which will not readily form a permanent lather with soap[cite: 1].

title: Soft water
content: Soft water is water which readily gives a permanent lather with soap[cite: 1].
